title: Extract embeddings engine from mmry into vqtrs
description: Standalone lean embeddings + reranking engine (vqtrs-core) backed by fastembed: ONNX models + Qwen3 candle backend + cross-encoder reranking. Exposes a Rust lib, a CLI (vqtrs), and an OpenAI-compatible HTTP server (vqtrs-api). Replaces mmry's in-process embeddings.

title: vqtrs-core engine: ONNX embedding backend

title: Unify model cache on the Hugging Face hub cache
description: ONNX path used a private ~/.cache/vqtrs/models; Qwen3 already used the HF cache. Standard practice (transformers/candle/TEI) is the shared HF hub cache honoring HF_HUB_CACHE/HF_HOME. model_cache_dir() now resolves there; migrated the 3 already-downloaded models (~1.1GB) into ~/.cache/huggingface/hub and removed the orphan dir. Verified embed reads from HF cache, no re-download.

title: vqtrs service: daemon lifecycle (start/run/stop/restart/status/enable/disable)
description: CLI 'server' subcommand managing vqtrs-api: start (detached, pidfile), run (foreground), stop, restart, status, enable/disable (systemd user unit). Matches house convention (trx pidfile pattern + octo systemd). CLI writes pidfile from spawned child PID so vqtrs-api stays a pure server.
close_reason: Implemented 'vqtrs server' start/run/stop/restart/status/enable/disable. CLI spawns vqtrs-api detached (pidfile + port + log under XDG_STATE_HOME), TCP readiness probe, sysinfo liveness; enable/disable manage a systemd user unit. Verified live: start/status/health/dup-refuse/restart/stop all correct. enable/disable write the correct unit + issue systemctl --user calls (couldn't exercise systemctl in the headless sandbox: no user D-Bus). Clippy/fmt clean.

title: Feature-gate the candle/qwen3 backend (default-off)
description: Currently fastembed 'qwen3' (candle-core/candle-nn + transformer code) is compiled into vqtrs-core unconditionally — the heaviest part of the build. Put it behind a 'qwen3' cargo feature gating both the fastembed dep feature and cfg(feature=qwen3) engine code (embed.rs Qwen3 path, catalog Qwen3 entries, Device/DType usage). Recommend DEFAULT OFF: lean ONNX-only default, opt in via --features qwen3. Independent of GPU work; implementable and verifiable on CPU now.
close_reason: Gated the candle/qwen3 backend behind a default-off 'qwen3' cargo feature (vqtrs-core + cli/api passthroughs). cfg-gated the candle imports, Qwen3 Inner variant + load/embed arms, Resolved::Qwen3, and resolve_dense (helpful error when off). Verified: default build pulls 0 candle deps and errors clearly on Qwen3 models; --features qwen3 pulls candle (3) and embeds Qwen3. clippy/fmt/tests clean in BOTH configs.

title: Interactive just installer for acceleration selection
description: Match house convention (mmry/eaRS/kokorox): scripts/install-vqtrs.sh detects hardware (nvidia-smi, OS/arch, macOS Apple Silicon) and runs 'cargo install --path crates/vqtrs-cli --features <string> --force' with the right accel features; justfile recipes install / install-cuda / install-tensorrt / install-coreml / install-metal / install-default / install-all (interactive). kokorox scripts/install-koko.sh is the cleanest template. Depends on the feature flags from candle-gating + GPU support.
close_reason: Interactive installer done: scripts/install-vqtrs.sh detects host (nvidia-smi/OS/arch), picks GPU accel + optional Qwen3, composes the feature string, cargo-installs vqtrs + vqtrs-api. justfile: install / install-all (interactive) / install-qwen3 / install-cuda / install-mac. Feature-composition matrix verified for all host/qwen3 combos; script syntax-checked.

title: Local IPC: Unix-domain-socket channel + CLI auto-routes to warm daemon
description: Better local channel than per-call CLI (reloads model each time) or TCP HTTP. Serve the existing embeddings/sparse/m3/rerank handlers over a Unix domain socket (no TCP, no port mgmt, filesystem-permission auth, model stays warm). Make the CLI embed/sparse/m3/rerank transparently route through the UDS when the vqtrs service is up, else load in-process. Keeps the CLI as the single surface (no MCP, per house style). In-process vqtrs-core lib stays the zero-IPC path for Rust. FFI/PyO3 bindings deferred to a separate issue if non-Rust in-process consumers appear.
close_reason: Implemented the local UDS channel. vqtrs-api now serves all routes over a Unix socket (default $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/vqtrs.sock, --socket/--no-socket) alongside TCP. CLI embed/sparse/m3/rerank transparently route to a warm daemon over the socket (sync HTTP/1.1 client, no async/extra deps), falling back in-process when down or when an explicit --model/--no-daemon is given. service status shows the live socket. Verified live: all 4 commands route to the daemon (returned the daemon's distinct model), --no-daemon forces in-process, and fallback works when the daemon is down. Also hardened socket-path resolution to require XDG_RUNTIME_DIR to actually exist. clippy/fmt/tests clean.

title: fzf model picker + downloader (vqtrs pull)
description: Ergonomic model download/prewarm: 'vqtrs pull [query]' pipes the catalog (code, dims, backend, task, description) into fzf for fuzzy filtering by any metric (type 1024, qwen3, cuda, splade, a language…), then downloads/warms the selected model into the HF cache via Engine::load. Fall back to a numbered prompt when fzf is absent; support non-interactive 'vqtrs pull <exact-code>'. Optional pre-filter flags (--backend, --task). Catalog may need a few more metadata columns (size, language) to filter on.

title: Multi-model server: honor request model, warm pool, hot-swap, LRU
description: Turn vqtrs-api from single-loaded-model into a multi-model gateway. Honor the OpenAI 'model' field per request: a keyed registry (HashMap<model, Arc<Engine>> behind a lock) that get-or-loads on demand and keeps models warm. Config: 'warm' list preloaded at startup; 'max_loaded' cap with LRU eviction (drop Arc -> frees model). Different models use different Mutexes -> parallel inference across models. Loads in spawn_blocking; dedupe concurrent loads of the same model (load-in-progress map). Once daemon serves any model, the CLI auto-route can drop the 'only-when-no-explicit-model' rule. Extends ServerConfig (warm, max_loaded). Applies to dense + sparse + rerank + m3 registries.
